title: SearchStaysResult
description: Checkpoint C.0.1 design contract (docs/adr/0003-phase2-checkpoint-c0-serving-contract.md §7/§9) for the shape of ProviderResponseEnvelope.result when provider='inside-airbnb-snapshot' / tool=search_stays. Not yet wired to a production tool. Every field here is either a fixed snapshot fact, a model output, or a deterministic Python computation -- never a live-availability or booking claim. A successful result always contains at least one supported stay with a produced prediction and interval; zero eligible rows is NOT a success (see NO_MATCHING_STAYS, ErrorEnvelope). Each stays[] item nests the existing StayOption under 'stay' and FairPriceEstimate under 'fair_price', both pinned to exactly schema_version 1.1.0 -- a nested 1.0.0 payload can never masquerade as this serving form.

model_version.description: Same value as every returned item's fair_price.model_version -- present at the top level too so a caller need not inspect stays[0] to learn it.

disclaimer.description: Fixed, server-authored snapshot-data disclaimer. Contract-tested to mention the snapshot and to never claim current availability, a live price, or a booking.

predictions_produced.description: Always true on a successful result: every returned stay has a produced prediction by construction (stays has minItems 1, and every item's fair_price is required). A request producing zero eligible rows is NO_MATCHING_STAYS, not a success with predictions_produced=false.

ranking_basis.description: Checkpoint C.0.1 §1: the only ranking basis search_stays itself ever produces. Never 'deal_score' -- that is System A's final ranking, computed after System B supplies itinerary_accessibility, entirely outside this tool.

excluded_row_count.description: Eligible, supported rows dropped because prediction failed unexpectedly for that row. Never silently merged into stays[].

stay.description: StayOption pinned to exactly schema_version 1.1.0 and tightened for search_stays use: room_type/availability_status/snapshot_date become required, and room_type is further restricted to the serving-supported subset only (a result row cannot represent an unsupported room type even by implementation bug).

fair_price.description: FairPriceEstimate pinned to exactly schema_version 1.1.0, with interval required -- every returned stay carries both a point prediction and a calibrated interval (Checkpoint C.0.1 §9). scoring_status may still be 'incomplete' (deal_score/components absent) -- that is expected and safe here, since search_stays never uses deal_score for ranking.

preliminary_capped_price_value.description: The exact preliminary ranking value used for this item (docs/adr/0003-phase2-checkpoint-c0-serving-contract.md §1) -- the already-accepted capped-price-value component applied to fair_price vs. the observed snapshot price only. Not the final deal_score; disclosed in full precision for transparency, never rounded before comparison.

estimated_total.description: Present if and only if the request supplied both check_in and check_out. Never present as an availability claim -- nights x nightly_price only.
